g.text: Lamp matrix row drivers. Row register 0x3FE4: bit(k-1)=1 turns row k on, clocked by /LMP ROW (J113-7). The 74HCT74 latches the data bit (true after U9); Q high -> IRLR024N on

g.desc: Lamp matrix row drivers. Row register 0x3FE4: bit(k-1)=1 turns row k on, clocked by /LMP ROW (J113-7). The 74HCT74 latches the data bit (true after U9); Q high -> IRLR024N on

g.text: (row = ground, ~65-80 mOhm DPAK). Over-current: source sense 0.22 R -> 1k/100n -> LM339; above the 1.4 V reference (6 A) the open-collector

g.desc: (row = ground, ~65-80 mOhm DPAK). Over-current: source sense 0.22 R -> 1k/100n -> LM339; above the 1.4 V reference (6 A) the open-collector

g.text: output pulls ~CLR low and the row is shut off until the next strobe. BLANKING pulls REF_1V4 low (CPU sheet) so all rows are forced off.

g.desc: output pulls ~CLR low and the row is shut off until the next strobe. BLANKING pulls REF_1V4 low (CPU sheet) so all rows are forced off.

g.text: Row k = Q(91-k): row1=Q90 ... row8=Q83. Outputs J133/J135 (pins 1,2,4-9; key 3).

g.desc: Row k = Q(91-k): row1=Q90 ... row8=Q83. Outputs J133/J135 (pins 1,2,4-9; key 3).
